title: Maigret Username Search output
description: The accounts found, one row per profile in the default dataset (switch between the Profiles found and Links and details views), plus a run summary record.

profiles.title: Profiles found (profiles)
profiles.description: Every account the run found, one row per profile: site, profile link, name, bio, location, followers, join date, photo, links and linked usernames. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: each username with its status, sites checked, sites that could not be checked, profiles found and saved, plus every note about how the input was read.
